content:
Alex: FYI GCP marketplace PM asked for a set of Terraform modules + reference arch for Redwood Private on GCP. They want: VPC, shared VPC connectors, private GKE + GPUs, and a marketplace-ready deployment manifest. Quick sync?
Maria: I can surface our current draft in repo: gitlab.com/redwood/infra/gcp-marketplace-templates. Will share link.
Sam: +1. We should aim for a single root module with clear variables and outputs. Suggest naming: modules/gcp/redwood_private.
Sam: minimal vars: project_id, region, network_id, enable_gpu (bool), node_pool_machine_type.
Jin: Need to include KMS integration and HSM placeholders for enterprise customers. Also add mapping for Dedicated vs Private (different networking + iam).
Maria: I'll drop a PR with skeleton. Tagging @Sam for variable standards and @Jin for security knobs.
Alex: Can we also include a sample Cloud Build pipeline that builds the marketplace artifact and signs it? Marketplace team cares about signed images and a manifest.
Sam: Yes. I'll add a `cloudbuild.yaml` snippet and a small `terraform` wrapper to produce a GCP marketplace solution package. Example snippet:```yaml
steps:
- name: 'gcr.io/cloud-builders/terraform'
  args: ['init']
- name: 'gcr.io/cloud-builders/terraform'
  args: ['apply','-auto-approve']
```
Jin: For GPUs, recommend T4 for dev/cost tests, A100 for perf lanes. Add a testing matrix in README and a variable to select GPU profile.
partners-bot: marketplace-checklist: license, manifest.yaml, deployment_manager/template.yaml, cloudbuild.yaml, billing_info, support_contact, signed_image_proof.
Maria: Uploaded initial skeleton: https://gitlab.com/redwood/infra/gcp-marketplace-templates/-/tree/marketplace-skeleton
Alex: Nice. Next steps: (1) Maria PR with modules + README (2) Sam adds variable/outputs lint + cloudbuild example (3) Jin adds KMS/HSM docs and example configs (4) produce a short demo script + manifest and hand off to marketplace PM. Also schedule 30m sync with GCP partner PM — who can join tomorrow 9am PT?
Sam: I can.
Jin: I can join after 9:30 — prefer 9:30 if possible.
Maria: I can.
Alex: Ok moving to 9:30 then. I'll send invite to GCP PM + marketplace wrangler. Thanks all :tada:
